y-m-10-05.title: Nemo ma'auratan lambobin goma-goma da jimillarsu 1
y-m-10-05.topic: Jimillar lamba mai wuri goma ɗaya da lamba mai wurare goma biyu (jimilloli bisa matsayi bayan alamar goma)
y-m-10-05.goal: Yanke ko haɗa lamba mai wuri goma ɗaya da lamba mai wurare goma biyu zai iya zama 1, ƙirƙiri ma'auratan lambobi masu wurare goma biyu masu jimillar 1, sannan ka bayyana tsarin jimillar lambobin kowane matsayi.
y-m-10-05.material: A wannan aiki, ‘lamba mai wuri goma ɗaya’ lamba ce mai lamba guda bayan alamar goma, kamar 0.4; ‘lamba mai wurare goma biyu’ tana da lamba ta biyu bayan alamar goma ba 0 ba, kamar 0.35. 0.30 daidai yake da 0.3 (0.30 = 0.3), saboda haka lamba ce mai wuri goma ɗaya. Dukkan lambobi sun fi 0 girma.
y-m-10-05.thinking.0: Da farko yanke ko zai yiwu ko ba zai yiwu ba, sannan nemo hujja
y-m-10-05.thinking.1: Rarrabe wasu gwaje-gwaje da bayani bisa matsayin lamba
y-m-10-05.thinking.2: Nemo tsari daga misalai da dama
y-m-10-05.prereq.0: Matsayin lambobi masu wuri goma ɗaya da wurare biyu (matakin aji na 4)
y-m-10-05.prereq.1: Kwarewar haɗa lambobin goma ta daidaita alamomin goma
y-m-10-05.s.s1.prompt: Idan ka haɗa lamba mai wuri goma ɗaya da lamba mai wurare goma biyu, akwai ma'aurata da za su zama daidai 1?
y-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.0: Sake bayyana da kalmominka yadda ƙa'idar da aka bayar ke rarrabe ‘lamba mai wuri goma ɗaya’ da ‘lamba mai wurare goma biyu’, sannan ka gwada lambobin zaɓuɓɓuka da ƙa'idar.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi lamba mai wuri goma ɗaya da lamba mai wurare goma biyu guda ɗaya kowanne, ka haɗa su, sannan ka rubuta lambar matsayi na biyu bayan alamar goma a jimillar kawai.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.o.a: Babu. Lambar matsayi na ɗari na jimillar iri ɗaya ce da lambar matsayi na ɗari ta lamba mai wurare goma biyu, don haka ba za ta zama 0 ba
y-m-10-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ya yi ƙoƙarin bayyana ta duba lambar kowane matsayi bayan alamar goma dabam.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.o.b: Akwai. Nemo ma'aurata kamar 0.4 da 0.6 waɗanda jimillarsu 1 ce
y-m-10-05.s.s1.r.b: Sake karanta ƙa’idar don ganin ko 0.6 adadi ne mai wuri ɗaya na decimal ko wurare biyu.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.o.c: Akwai. Za ka iya samun ma’aurata da jimillarsu 1, kamar 0.55 da 0.45.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.r.c: Ka sami ma’aurata da jimillarsu 1, amma ka duba ko lambobin duka iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.o.d: Idan na tara ma’aurata da yawa ba ya fitowa, zan iya cewa babu, amma ban gwada kowane ma’aurata ba, don haka ban tabbata ba.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka yanke hukunci daga sakamakon gwaje-gwaje kaɗan, amma ka kuma yi tunani kan irin tabbacin da ke akwai.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.explain: Lamba mai wuri ɗaya na decimal tana da wuri na biyu babu komai (wato 0). Saboda haka lambobi a wuri na biyu na jimillar su ne lambobi na biyu na lambar mai wurare biyu, kuma bisa yarjejeniyar wannan lambar ba 0 ba ce. Don jimillar ta zama 1 (= 1.00), wuri na biyu dole ya zama 0, saboda haka babu irin waɗannan ma’aurata. Gwada ma’aurata da yawa mafari ne mai kyau, kuma bayanin darajar matsayi ya shafi dukkan yiwuwar lokaci guda.
y-m-10-05.s.s1.acc.0: Ka nuna daidai cewa gwaje-gwaje kaɗai ba za su tabbatar da “dukkan lokuta” ba. Idan za ka iya bayyana ta darajar matsayi, za ka iya cewa tabbatacciya ce.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon, nemo ma’aurata na lambobi biyu-biyu masu wurare biyu na decimal waɗanda jimillarsu daidai 1 ce. Lambobin biyu dole ne kowannensu ya kasance da lambar wuri na biyu da ba 0 ba. Yi ma’aurata uku daban-daban. (Ma’auratan da aka juya tsarinsu kaɗai iri ɗaya ne.)
y-m-10-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fara zaɓar lamba ɗaya, sannan ka duba cewa darajar da ka samu idan ka cire ta daga 1 ba ta da 0 a wuri na biyu.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta kowace ma’aurata da ka yi, ka raba wuraren decimal na farko da na biyu, sannan ka kwatanta jimillar lambobi a kowane wuri.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne lambobin biyu su fi 0.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.ok.c2: Lambobin biyu sun kai har wuri na biyu na decimal.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Akwai lambobi fiye da biyu bayan alamar decimal (wuri na uku ko gaba), ko lambobin ba su dace ba.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.ok.c3: A cikin lambobin biyu, lambar decimal ta biyu ba 0 ba ce.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Akwai lamba da lambar decimal ta biyu 0 ce (misali: 0.4). 0.4 lamba ce mai wuri ɗaya na decimal.
y-m-10-05.s.s2.explain: Akwai ma’aurata kamar 0.35+0.65, 0.12+0.88, da 0.99+0.01. Lambobin mai wuri ɗaya na decimal 0.4 da 0.6 ba su dace da wannan yarjejeniya ba. Idan lambar decimal ta biyu ta lamba ɗaya 5 ce, lambar ta biyu ta ɗayan ma dole ta zama 5 (5+5=10).
y-m-10-05.s.s3.prompt: A cikin ma’auratan da jimillarsu 1 ce, me kake samu idan ka tara lambobin wurin decimal na farko, da kuma lambobin wurin na biyu? Yi amfani da ma’aurata ɗaya da ka yi a matsayin misali ka rubuta tsarin.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta ma’aurata ɗaya da ka yi a jere tsaye, sannan ka tara lambobin wurin decimal na farko da na biyu dabam-dabam.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.hint.1: Gwada ko wasu ma’aurata suna ba da ƙimomi iri ɗaya.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta a sarari cewa jimillar wuraren farko da jimillar wuraren na biyu ƙimomi daban-daban ne?
y-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka gwada ko tsarin yana aiki ga ma’auratan da ba waɗanda ka zaɓa ba?
y-m-10-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana abin da ke faruwa a wuri na farko idan jimillar wuraren na biyu ta zama 10?
y-m-10-05.s.s3.model.0: Lambobin wurin decimal na farko sun tara zuwa 9, na wurin na biyu kuma sun tara zuwa 10. Ga 0.35 da 0.65 ma, 3+6=9 ne, 5+5=10 kuma.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.model.1: Jimillar wurare na biyu ta zama 10, saboda haka ana ɗaukar 1 zuwa wuri na farko; jimillar wurare na farko ta zama 9, idan aka ƙara 1 ta zama 10, ana ɗaukar 1 kuma don a sami 1. Na gwada da 0.12 da 0.88.
y-m-10-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wannan amsar ta bayyana tsarin ta amfani da ɗaukar 1.

y-m-10-01.title: Wane ƙauye ne ya fi yawan jama'a?
y-m-10-01.topic: Kwatanta lambobi manya (yawan lambobi, sannan kwatanta daga matsayi mafi girma)
y-m-10-01.goal: Bayyana yadda ake yanke girma idan lambobin suna da yawan lambobi mabambanta, da matsayi wane ne ke yanke sakamako idan yawan lambobi iri ɗaya ne. Yanke bayanin da ake buƙata domin kwatantawa idan an ɓoye lamba.
y-m-10-01.material: Kana son kwatanta yawan mutanen Garam Village (가람마을) da Narae Village (나래마을). Lambobin da ke allon sanarwa duk cikakkun lambobi ne, ana sanya waƙafi (,) bayan kowane lambobi uku, lambar farko kuma ba 0 ba ce. Ma'auni shi ne '명' (mutane).
y-m-10-01.thinking.0: Yanke ko bayanin ya isa kwatantawa
y-m-10-01.thinking.1: Bayyana da jimlar idan-to dalilin da ya sa ake kwatantawa daga matsayi mafi girma
y-m-10-01.thinking.2: Bambanta 'ainihin ƙima' da 'bayanin da ya isa kwatantawa'
y-m-10-01.prereq.0: Matsayin lambobi da karanta manyan lambobi zuwa miliyoyi (matakin aji na 4)
y-m-10-01.prereq.1: Karanta lambobin da aka rubuta da waƙafi bayan kowane lambobi uku
y-m-10-01.s.s1.prompt: Da farko, yanayi inda ake ganin duk lambobi. Garam Village yana da mutane 987,654 (ɗari tara da tamanin da bakwai dubu ɗari shida da hamsin da huɗu), Narae Village kuma 1,000,000 (miliyan ɗaya). Wane ƙauye ne ya fi mutane?
y-m-10-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ƙirga lambobi domin ganin lambobi nawa kowace lamba take da su.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin nawa za ka ƙara wa 987,654 domin samu 1,000,000, ka duba bambancin lambobin.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.a: Garam Village. Lambobin manya kamar 9, 8, 7 ne suka fara, don haka ya fi girma.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka kalli girman lambobin farko. Ka duba ko wannan hanya tana aiki idan lambobin biyu suna da yawan lambobi iri ɗaya da idan sun bambanta.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.b: Narae Village. Garam Village yana da lamba mai lambobi shida, Narae Village kuma mai lambobi bakwai.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ra'ayi ne na fara ƙirga yawan lambobi maimakon kallon kowace lamba.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya yanke hukunci ba. Ƙungiyoyin da waƙafi ya raba sun bambanta, saboda haka ba za a kwatanta su ba.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi tunanin ba za a iya kwatanta lambobin ba idan ƙungiyoyin waƙafi sun bambanta. Waƙafi alama ce kawai da ke sauƙaƙa karatu. Ka yi tunanin abin da ke ƙayyade girman lamba.
y-m-10-01.s.s1.explain: Ga cikakkun lambobi waɗanda lambar farko ba 0 ba ce, mai yawan lambobi shi ne babba. 987,654 lamba ce mai lambobi shida, 1,000,000 kuma mai lambobi bakwai. Ko lambobin gaba 9, 8, 7 suna kama da manya, ba ya taimakawa. Za ka iya tabbatarwa cewa idan an ƙara 12,346 ga 987,654, za a samu 1,000,000.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon allon ya sami tabo. Garam Village yana da mutane 3,□45,678 (□ wata lamba ce da aka ɓoye a matsayin matsayi na ɗaruruwan dubu), Narae Village kuma yana da mutane 3,500,000 (miliyan uku da dubu ɗari biyar). Me kake buƙatar sani domin yanke wane ƙauye ya fi yawan jama'a?
y-m-10-01.s.s2.hint.0: Jera lambobin biyu gefe da gefe, matsayi-matsayi tun daga mafi girma, ka nemo matsayi na farko da lambobinsa suka bambanta.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada saka 0 da 9 cikin □ ka duba ko wane ƙauye ya fi yawa yana canzawa.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.a: Lambar Garam Village tana da 45,678 a ɓangaren baya, Narae Village kuma 00,000 ne, don haka Garam Village ya fi yawa ko da ba a san □ ba.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.a: Ka kwatanta lambobin bisa ɓangaren bayansu. Idan lambobin gaba sun bambanta a matsayi ɗaya, ɓangaren baya ba ya shafar sakamako. Saka 0 cikin □ ka kwatanta kai tsaye.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.b: Za ka iya yanke hukunci idan ka san ainihin ƙimar □ kawai.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.b: Ka yi tunanin dole ne ka san ainihin ƙimar □. Gwada saka lambobi kaɗan cikin □ domin bincika ko sanin zangon kawai ya isa kwatantawa.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.c: Sanin ko □ ya kai 4 ko ƙasa, ko 5 ko sama, ya isa a yanke hukunci.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.c: Ka gano iyakar da sakamakon kwatanci ke canzawa, ka bayyana bayanin da ake buƙata a matsayin 'zango', ba 'ƙima' ba.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.o.d: Ko ba tare da sanin □ ba, kwatanta wurin raka'a: 8 na Garam Village ya fi 0 na Narae Village, saboda haka Garam Village ya fi yawa.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.r.d: Ka fara kwatantawa daga mafi ƙaramin matsayi. Ka yi tunanin matsayi wane ya kamata a fara dubawa yayin kwatanta manyan lambobi.
y-m-10-01.s.s2.explain: Matsayin miliyoyi a lambobin biyu 3 ne, saboda haka a kwatanta matsayi na gaba, ɗaruruwan dubu. Narae Village yana da 5. Idan □ ya zama 6~9, Garam Village ya fi yawa; idan ya zama 0~4, Narae Village ya fi yawa. Idan □ ya zama 5, matsayinsu na ɗaruruwan dubu ɗaya ne, don haka a duba matsayi na gaba. Matsayin dubun dubu 4 ne ga Garam Village da 0 ga Narae Village, saboda haka Garam Village ya fi yawa (3,545,678 > 3,500,000). Don haka ko ba a san ainihin □ ba, sanin '4 ko ƙasa ne ko 5 ko sama' ya isa yanke hukunci.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.prompt: Sakamakon yana canzawa bisa lambar da ke □. Ta amfani da sharuddan 'idan □ ya zama ...', rubuta yanayin da Garam Village ya fi yawa da wanda Narae Village ya fi yawa. Ka kuma rubuta matsayin da ka kwatanta domin yanke hukuncin.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta lambar da 5 ya maye gurbin □ da ta Narae Village gefe da gefe tun daga matsayi mafi girma.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.hint.1: Da farko rubuta wane ƙauye ne ya fi yawa idan □ ya zama 4 da kuma idan ya zama 6.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka duba dabam abin da ke faruwa idan □ ya zama 5?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Amsarka ta nuna jerin: matsayin miliyoyi daidai ne, saboda haka an kwatanta matsayi na gaba?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka gwada yanayin ta saka ainihin lambobi (misali 2 da 7) cikin □?
y-m-10-01.s.s3.model.0: Idan □ ya zama 5 ko fiye, Garam Village ya fi yawa; idan 4 ko ƙasa, Narae Village ya fi yawa. Matsayin miliyoyi 3 ne a duka biyun, saboda haka na kwatanta □ a matsayi ɗaruruwan dubu da 5.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.model.1: Idan □ ya zama 4 ko ƙasa, Narae Village ya fi yawa; idan daga 5 zuwa 9 ne, Garam Village ya fi yawa. Matsayi mafi girma, na miliyoyi, iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka na duba matsayi na gaba.
y-m-10-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ba a bayyana dalilin saka yanayin □=5 cikin 5 zuwa 9 ba, amma an raba iyakar daidai.

y-m-10-02.title: Amsar Seoa: za mu iya amincewa da ita?
y-m-10-02.topic: Bincika sakamakon (lamba mai lambobi uku)×(lamba mai lambobi biyu) (ƙiyasin, lambar raka'a, daidaita matsayi)
y-m-10-02.goal: Ba tare da sake yin lissafi ba, yi amfani da ƙiyasin da lambar raka'a domin gano cewa amsar ba daidai ba ce, nemo layin kuskure a mafita ka bayyana dalili, sannan ka ƙirƙiri ninkawa naka da ke wuce binciken biyu masu sauri.
y-m-10-02.material: Littafin rubutu ɗaya yana kan farashi 347원. Domin nemo farashin littattafai 23, Seoa ta yi ninkawa a rubutacciyar hanya ta rubuta amsa 1,735원. Ana iya ganin lissafin Seoa a mataki na biyu. Da farko, ba tare da sake lissafi ba, ka yi tunanin ko za a iya amincewa da amsar.
y-m-10-02.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci da dalili ko sakamako yana da ma'ana
y-m-10-02.thinking.2: Nemo layin farko da kuskure ya faru
y-m-10-02.thinking.3: Ƙirƙiri misalin kanka da ya cika sharuɗɗa
y-m-10-02.prereq.0: Gwajin lissafin (lamba mai lambobi uku)×(lamba mai lamba ɗaya) da (lamba mai lambobi biyu)×(lamba mai lambobi biyu)
y-m-10-02.prereq.1: Gwajin ƙiyasin da lambobi na kusa a ɗaruruwa da gomomi
y-m-10-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk abin da za ka iya amfani da shi a matsayin hujjar cewa amsar Seoa 1,735원 ba daidai ba ce. (Abubuwan da za a iya sani ba tare da sake lissafi tun farko ba)
y-m-10-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ko za ka iya ƙiyasta ƙima kusa da girman amsar Seoa cikin sauƙi.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada mayar da 347 da 23 zuwa lambobi na kusa a ɗaruruwa da gomomi, ko duba samfurin lambobin wane matsayi ne ke yanke lambar raka'a ta amsar.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.a: 1,735 lamba ce mai lambobi huɗu kuma 347×23 ma kamar lamba mai lambobi huɗu ce, saboda haka da alama daidai ne.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.a: Ka kalli gaskiyar cewa yawan lambobi ɗaya ne kawai. Lambobi masu lambobi huɗu suna da faɗin zangon 1,000 zuwa 9,999, saboda haka wannan bai isa yanke girma ba.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.b: Idan ka ɗauki 347 a matsayin kusan 300, 23 kuma kusan 20, amsar za ta zama kusan 300×20=6,000, don haka 1,735 ya yi ƙasa sosai.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.b: Da farko ka yi ƙiyasin girman gaba ɗaya ta mayar da lambobin biyu zuwa lambobi kusa a ɗaruruwa da gomomi.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.c: Idan ka sake lissafi iri ɗaya ka samu ƙima ɗaya, daidai ne.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.c: Idan ka maimaita hanya ɗaya, kuskure iri ɗaya na iya maimaituwa. Ka yi tunanin bincike da wata hanya dabam.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.o.d: Tun da 7×3=21, lambar raka'a ta amsa dole ta zama 1, amma 1,735 ta ƙare da 5.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi amfani da ƙa'idar cewa lambar raka'a ta samfurin ninkawa ana ƙayyade ta samfurin lambobin raka'a.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.explain: b da d sun kai ga ƙarshe ɗaya (ba 1,735 ba) ta hanyoyi dabam. b ya bincika girman, d kuma lambar raka'a. a ya nuna cewa yawan lambobi ɗaya ne kawai, don haka hujjarsa rauni ce; c kuma na iya maimaita kuskure iri ɗaya. Da ƙiyasin ko binciken lambar raka'a za ka iya tabbatar da cewa 'ba daidai ba' ne, amma ko da ya wuce duka biyun ba za ka iya kammala cewa 'daidai' ne ba.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.acc.0: Ƙiyasin kaɗai ya nuna 1,735 ya yi ƙasa sosai. Binciken lambar raka'a (d) ma hujja ce mai zaman kanta.
y-m-10-02.s.s1.acc.1: Lambar raka'a kaɗai ta nuna ba daidai ba ne. Ƙiyasin girma (b) wata hujja ce.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.prompt: Karanta mafitar Seoa layi bayan layi. Wane layi ne na farko da bai daidai ba?
y-m-10-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko ninkawa da ƙari a kowane layi daidai ne.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.hint.1: A kowane layi, rubuta ainihin ma'anar lambar da aka ninka, sannan ka kwatanta yadda aka jera matsayi lokacin haɗa samfurorin.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.line.0: Ninka da lambar raka’a 3 da farko. 347 × 3 = 1041, saboda haka rubuta 1041 a layi na farko.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.line.1: Ninka da lambar goma-goma 2. 347 × 2 = 694, saboda haka rubuta 694 a layi na biyu, ka daidaita shi da ƙarshen dama na layi na farko.
y-m-10-02.s.s2.explain: Kuskuren farko yana layi na 2. 2 a cikin 23 lambar goma-goma ce, tana nufin 20, don haka dole ne a ƙara 347×20=6940. Idan ka rubuta 694 a daidai ƙarshen dama, kana ƙara 694, ba 6940 ba. Haɗin layi na 3 daidai ne shi kaɗai, amma lambobin da aka haɗa ba daidai ba ne, saboda haka hukuncin layi na 4 ma kuskure ne. Amsa daidai ita ce 1041 + 6940 = 7981.
y-m-10-02.s.s3.prompt: Ƙirƙiri ninkawa biyu masu samfurori daban da suka cika tantancewar kimantawa (samfurin 6,000 ko fiye, 8,000 ko ƙasa) da duban lambar ɗaya (samfurin ya ƙare da 1). Lambar da ake ninkawa a mai lambobi uku ce, mai ninkawa b kuma mai lambobi biyu. An riga an yi amfani da 347×23, kada ka yi amfani da ita.
y-m-10-02.s.s3.hint.0: Lambar ɗaya ta samfurin iri ɗaya ce da ta samfurin lambobin ɗaya biyu. Nemo ma'auratan lambobi ɗaya da ke ba da 1.
y-m-10-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bayan ka zaɓi ma'auratan lambobin ɗaya, canza lambar mai lambobi uku da mai lambobi biyu ka yi kimantawa ko samfurin yana tsakanin 6,000 da 8,000.
y-m-10-02.s.s3.var.a: Lambar da ake ninkawa (mai lambobi uku)
y-m-10-02.s.s3.ok.c1: a lamba ce ta halitta mai lambobi uku.
y-m-10-02.s.s3.fail.c1: a dole ta zama lamba ta halitta daga 100 zuwa 999.

y-m-10-03.title: Akwatuna na apple 200
y-m-10-03.topic: Fassara rabo da ragowar rabon da yake da saura bisa yanayin tambayar
y-m-10-03.goal: Fahimci cewa rabo da saura iri ɗaya suna zama amsoshi daban idan tambaya ta canza, sannan ta ƙirƙirar lambobi masu yiwuwa ga rabo da saura da aka bayar, a duba sharadin ‘saura ya fi mai raba ƙanƙanta’.
y-m-10-03.material: Shagon 'ya'yan itace yana da apple 200. Akwati guda na ɗaukar apple har 12. 200 ÷ 12 yana ba da rabo 16 da saura 8 (12×16=192 da 200-192=8).
y-m-10-03.thinking.0: Canza ko riƙe hukunci bisa sabon sharadi
y-m-10-03.thinking.1: Fassara sakamakon lissafi ɗaya domin ya dace da yanayi
y-m-10-03.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri mafita da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗa
y-m-10-03.prereq.0: Ma'anar rabo da saura a (lamba mai lambobi uku)÷(mai lambobi biyu)
y-m-10-03.prereq.1: Kwarewar bincika rabo ta ninkawa da haɗawa
y-m-10-03.s.s1.prompt: Bi bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya domin ganin yadda aka yi amfani da sakamakon lissafi ɗaya (rabo 16, saura 8) bisa tambaya.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da aka bayar da bayani, bayyana da kalmomi inda apple 8 suke.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.hint.1: Idan kowace amsa daidai ce, duba adadin apple gabaɗaya ta ninka da 12.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Mai shagon ya ce, “Ina so in saka apple cikin akwatuna in ajiye.” Ba a ce wani abu ba tukuna.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Akwatuna nawa ake buƙata? Zaɓi tunaninka yanzu.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan ka fassara ‘saka a akwatuna a ajiye’ a matsayin saka duka, akwatuna 17 ne; tunanin fara duba abin da za a yi da apple 8 ma ya dace. Akwatuna 16 amsa ce da ba ta sanya apple 8 ko'ina ba.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka rubuta rabo kaɗai a matsayin amsa ba tare da tunanin abin da zai faru da apple 8 da suka rage ba.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Akwatuna 17. Dole ne a saka apple 8 da suka rage ma, saboda haka ana buƙatar akwati guda ƙari
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka fassara cewa za a saka apple 8 da suka rage a akwati ma.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba za a iya yankewa ba. Dole mu san abin da za a yi da apple 8 da suka rage
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka gano bayanin da ya ɓace daga tambayar.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Mai shagon ya ƙara cewa, “Zan iya sayar wa kwastomomi akwatunan da suka cika da apple 12 kawai.”
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: To akwatuna nawa za a iya sayar wa kwastomomi?
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Akwatuna 16 sun cika, apple 8 kuma sun rage domin ba su cika akwati ba. A wannan tambaya, rabo 16 ne amsa.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Akwatuna 17. Ana iya sayar da akwati mai apple da suka rage ma
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ba ka yi amfani da sabon sharadin da ka ji yanzu ba, ‘cikakkun akwatuna kawai’.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Akwatuna 16. Ana ƙirga cikakkun akwatuna kawai, saboda haka daidai yake da rabo
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka yi la'akari da sharadin cewa ana ƙirga ‘cikakkun akwatuna’ kawai.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Akwatuna 8. Za ka iya sayar da adadin saura
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka fassara ragowa 8 a matsayin adadin akwatuna. Ragowa adadin apple ne da ya rage.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Mai shagon ya canza ra'ayi. “Kada mu zubar da apple da suka rage; saka su duka cikin akwatuna mu ajiye a ma'ajiya. Akwati ɗaya yana ɗaukar har 12.”
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Akwatuna nawa za a ajiye a ma'ajiya, kuma apple nawa ne a akwati na ƙarshe?
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Daga akwatuna 17, 16 suna ɗauke da apple 12 kowanne, wato 192; akwati na ƙarshe kuma yana da apple 8 da suka rage (192+8=200). Domin cika akwatuna 17 duka sai an buƙaci 12×17=204 apple, saboda haka apple 4 za su gaza.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Akwatuna 16, apple 12 a akwati na ƙarshe
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ba ka yanke inda za a saka apple 8 da suka rage ba.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Akwatuna 17, apple 12 a akwati na ƙarshe
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka ƙirga adadin akwatuna daidai, amma duba apple nawa za su kasance idan akwatuna 17 duka sun cika.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Akwatuna 17, apple 8 a akwati na ƙarshe
y-m-10-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka yi tunanin saka saura a akwati na ƙarshe.
y-m-10-03.s.s1.reflect: Da farko b da c duka sun dace (domin ba mu san abin da za a yi da apple 8 ba). Bisa sabon sharadi amsar ta zama 16 ko 17. Ko da sakamakon lissafi ɗaya ne, idan tambayar ‘cikakkun kawai’ ce ko ‘dukkansu’ ce, ana amfani da rabo yadda yake ko a ƙara 1 a kansa.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon, mu yi tunanin komawa baya. An raba lamba a mai lambobi uku da b mai lambobi biyu, rabo 15 ne saura kuma 17 (rabon: a ÷ b = 15 … 17). Ƙirƙiri ma'auratan a da b guda biyu masu ƙimar b daban.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sake bayyana ‘rabo 15 ne, saura 17’ a matsayin ‘b yana shiga wasu lokuta kuma wani abu ya rage’, ka rubuta furucin a ta amfani da b. Sannan zaɓi lamba guda ga b ka ƙirƙiri a.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.hint.1: Raba a da ka ƙirƙira da b da gaske domin duba ko rabon 15 da saura 17 ne, sannan ka kwatanta saura da b.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.var.a: Lambar da aka raba (mai lambobi uku)
y-m-10-03.s.s2.ok.c3: b yana shiga sau 15, saura kuma 17.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c3: a ba lambar da ake samu ta ƙara 17 ga b×15 ba. Gwada gina a daga rabo da saura ta hanyar komawa baya.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Saura 17 ya fi ko ya yi daidai da mai raba b. Idan aka raba wannan daidaito da gaske, rabo da saura za su canza.
y-m-10-03.s.s2.explain: a = b×15+17. Misali, idan b=20, to a=317, kuma 317÷20 yana ba da rabo 15 saura 17. Duk da haka saura dole ya gaza mai raba, don haka b dole ya fi 17; domin a ya zama lamba mai lambobi uku, b dole ya zama 65 ko ƙasa da haka. Saboda haka kowace lamba ta halitta b daga 18 zuwa 65 ta dace.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.prompt: Minho ya zaɓi b=12 da a=197 ya rubuta ‘197 ÷ 12 = 15 … 17’. Rubuta dalilin da ya sa wannan ba zai zama sakamakon rabo daidai ba, sannan rubuta ainihin rabo da saura idan an raba 197 da 12.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta adadin da ya rage bayan cire 12 daga 197 sau 15 da 12.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko za ka iya sake cire 12 daga abin da ya rage sau ɗaya, sannan ka rubuta yadda rabo da saura suka canza.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka duba sau nawa 12 ke shiga cikin saura 17?
y-m-10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bincika ainihin rabo da saura ta 12×(rabo)+(saura)=197?
y-m-10-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana da kalmominka dalilin da ya sa saura dole ya gaza mai raba?
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.0: Dalili shi ne saura 17 ya fi mai raba 12 girma. 12 yana shiga cikin 17 sau ɗaya ƙari, don haka idan ka yi 197÷12 da gaske, rabo 16 ne saura 5.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.1: Lambar da ta rage bayan rabawa da 12 dole ta gaza 12, amma 17 ta rage, don haka za a iya sake rabawa sau ɗaya. Saboda haka 197 = 12×16 + 5.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: An yi amfani da ‘adadin da ya rage’ maimakon kalmar ‘saura’, amma ma'ana ɗaya ce.
y-m-10-03.s.s3.model.2: 17 ya fi 12, don haka ana iya sake cire 12 sau ɗaya, hakan yana nufin kuskure ne. 197÷12 yana da rabo 16 da saura 5.

y-m-10-04.title: Kasusuwa masu ma'aunin ƙasa 7 da ɓangaren cikakken lamba 2
y-m-10-04.topic: Alaƙar kaso mara dacewa da gaurayen lamba masu ma'aunin ƙasa ɗaya (nemo kaso mara dacewa mai ɓangaren cikakken lamba iri ɗaya)
y-m-10-04.goal: Nemo layin kuskure a mafitar kaso ta kimantawa (kwatanta girma), gano duk lambobin sama da suka cika sharadi, sannan ka faɗaɗa tsarin. Bayyana dalilin ware iyakokin da suka zama cikakkun lambobi daga gaurayen lambobi.
y-m-10-04.material: Kaso na yau da kullum kaso ne da lambar sama ta gaza lambar ƙasa; kaso mara dacewa lambar sama ta yi daidai ko ta fi lambar ƙasa; gaurayen lamba kuma lamba ce mai cikakken lamba da kaso na yau da kullum (misali 2 da 3/7). Kaso da ya zama cikakkiyar lamba daidai, kamar 14/7, cikakkiyar lamba ce, ba gauraye ba. A wannan aiki, lambar sama ta kaso lamba ce ta halitta.
y-m-10-04.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗa
y-m-10-04.thinking.3: Yin tunani game da ƙa'idar ƙirga idan ma'aunin ƙasa ya canza
y-m-10-04.prereq.0: Sunaye da ma'anar kaso na yau da kullum, kaso mara dacewa, da gaurayen lambobi (matakin aji na 4)
y-m-10-04.prereq.1: Kwarewar canza cikakkiyar lamba zuwa kaso mai ma'aunin ƙasa iri ɗaya
y-m-10-04.s.s1.prompt: Hangyeol ya rubuta mafita don canza ‘3 da 2/5’ zuwa kaso mara dacewa. Wane layi ne farkon kuskure?
y-m-10-04.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko yi tunanin wanne ya fi girma, 3 da 2/5 ko 3, sannan ka kwatanta da sakamakon ƙarshe na mafitar.
y-m-10-04.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko duba kaso mai ma'aunin ƙasa 5 da ya yi daidai da cikakkiyar lamba 1.
y-m-10-04.s.s1.line.0: Mu rubuta cikakkiyar lamba 3 a cikin 3 da 2/5 a matsayin kaso mai ma'aunin ƙasa 5.
y-m-10-04.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka 3 da 2/5 daidai yake da 5/5, wato 1.
y-m-10-04.s.s1.explain: Kuskuren farko yana layi na 2. 1=5/5, don haka 3=15/5. 3/5 ya gaza 1, ba zai yi daidai da 3 ba. Sakamakon layi na 4 ma kuskure ne, domin 3 da 2/5 ya fi 3 amma an ce 1. Mafita daidai ita ce haɗa 15/5 da 2/5 a sami 17/5.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.prompt: Daga kaso marasa dacewa masu ma'aunin ƙasa 7, nemo kaso uku da idan aka rubuta gaurayen lamba ɓangaren cikakken lambar su 2 ne, ka shigar da lambobin samansu. (A cikin □/7, □ lambar sama ce. Tunda gaurayen lamba ce, dole ta ƙunshi ɓangaren kaso na yau da kullum.)
y-m-10-04.s.s2.hint.0: Idan lambar sama 7, 8, 9, … ce, mayar da □/7 zuwa gaurayen lamba ka rubuta a tebur yadda ɓangaren cikakken lambar ke canzawa.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.hint.1: Daga tebur, zaɓi layukan da ɓangaren cikakken lambar 2 ne kawai, kwatanta lambobin sama, sannan ka duba ko ɓangaren kaso na yau da kullum ya rage.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Lambar sama lamba ce ta halitta.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Lambar sama dole ta zama lambar halitta aƙalla 1.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Lambar sama ta yi daidai ko ta fi ma'aunin ƙasa, don haka kaso mara dacewa ne.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan lambar sama ta gaza 7, kaso na yau da kullum ne. Mayar da shi kaso mara dacewa.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Idan aka canza shi gaurayen lamba, ɓangaren cikakkiyar lamba 2 ne.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan aka canza shi gaurayen lamba, ɓangaren cikakkiyar lambar ba 2 ba ce. Duba □/7 yana daidai da 2 nawa.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Yana da ɓangaren kaso na yau da kullum, don haka gaurayen lamba ne.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Lamba ce da ta zama cikakkiyar lamba daidai. Zaɓi lambar sama da za ta bar ɓangaren kaso na yau da kullum.
y-m-10-04.s.s2.explain: 14/7 cikakkiyar lamba 2 ce, 21/7 kuma 3 ce. Gaurayen lambobin da ɓangaren cikakkiyar lambarsu 2 su ne 2 da 1/7 har zuwa 2 da 6/7; idan aka canza su zuwa kaso mara dacewa, guda 6 ne masu lambobin sama 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon ma'aunin ƙasa 9 ne. Idan aka rubuta su gaurayen lambobi, kaso mara dacewa nawa ne suke da ɓangaren cikakkiyar lamba 2?
y-m-10-04.s.s3.hint.0: Idan ma'aunin ƙasa 9 ne, rubuta duk lambobin da za su iya shiga □ a gaurayen lamba 2 da □/9.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.hint.1: Duba lambar da za ka samu idan □ = 0 ko 9, ka yanke ko za a haɗa waɗannan yanayi biyu.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.o.a: 6. Ƙidayar iri ɗaya ce ko da ma'aunin ƙasa ya canza
y-m-10-04.s.s3.r.a: Ka ɗauka ƙidayar ma'aunin ƙasa 7 za ta ci gaba da zama iri ɗaya. Duba ta lissafa lambobin sama da kanka ga ma'aunin ƙasa 9.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.r.b: Ka haɗa lambar sama 18. Duba ko 18/9 cikakkiyar lamba ce ko gauraye.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.r.c: Ka haɗa lambobin ƙarshen biyu. Duba 18/9 da 27/9 kowannensu nawa ne.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.r.d: Wannan tunani ne na ƙirga ba tare da ƙarshen biyun ba, waɗanda suke zama cikakkun lambobi daidai.
y-m-10-04.s.s3.explain: Gaurayen lambobin da ɓangaren cikakkiyar lambarsu 2 su ne 2 da 1/9 har 2 da 8/9, guda 8. Idan aka canza su kaso marasa dacewa, lambobin sama su ne 19 zuwa 26. 18/9=2, 27/9=3, saboda haka ba gaurayen lambobi ba ne. Ƙidayar 6 ce ga ma'aunin ƙasa 7, 8 ga 9, don haka ƙidayar = (ma'aunin ƙasa - 1). Dalili kuwa lambar sama ta ɓangaren kaso na yau da kullum na iya zama daga 1 zuwa (ma'aunin ƙasa - 1).

y-m-10-06.title: Za a iya sanin watan gobe daga bayanan watanni uku?
y-m-10-06.topic: Kirga da tsallakewa ta manyan lambobi da iyakar hasashen ta amfani da ƙa’ida
y-m-10-06.goal: Yi hasashen lamba ta gaba daga bayanan da ke ƙirga da tsallake 100,000, amma ka nuna da misalin da ya saba cewa bayanai kaɗan ba sa tabbatar da hakan, sannan ka bambanta hasashe da tabbaci.
y-m-10-06.material: Wani wurin shakatawa ya rubuta yawan baƙi kowane wata. An rubuta bayanan a rukunin mutane 10,000 kawai, saboda haka dukkan lambobin ninkin 10,000 ne. Janairu mutane 3,420,000 ne, Fabrairu 3,520,000, Maris kuma 3,620,000. Mina ta ce, “Yana ƙaruwa da mutane 100,000 kowane wata, don haka tabbas Afrilu zai zama mutane 3,720,000!”
y-m-10-06.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci kan irin tabbacin hasashe bisa ƙa’ida
y-m-10-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar misalin da ya saba wanda ke karya “tabbas”
y-m-10-06.thinking.2: Rubuta hasashe da ikirari tabbatacce a matsayin abubuwa daban-daban
y-m-10-06.prereq.0: Karanta da rubuta manyan lambobi a rukunin dubu ɗari da miliyoyi (matakin aji na 4)
y-m-10-06.prereq.1: Ƙirga da tsallakewa da adadi tabbatacce
y-m-10-06.s.s1.prompt: Wane tunani ne ya fi dacewa game da abin da Mina ta ce?
y-m-10-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo yawan ƙarin mutane daga Janairu zuwa Fabrairu, da daga Fabrairu zuwa Maris.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yanayi guda da darajar Afrilu za ta iya bambanta (misali yanayi ko wani taro), sannan ka yi tunanin ko bayanan kaɗai za su iya gaya maka hakan.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.a: Hasashen kusan mutane 3,720,000 abu ne mai ma’ana, amma daraja daban na iya fitowa.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka karanta ƙa’idar daga bayanan, sannan ka bambanta hasashe da tabbaci.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.b: Tabbas mutane 3,720,000 ne. Domin ya ƙaru da 100,000 a duk watanni ukun.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.b: Daga kasancewar ya faru haka sau uku, ka yanke cewa zai kasance haka koyaushe. Ka yi tunanin ko akwai shaida cewa karo na huɗu ma zai zama haka.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.c: Ba za a iya sanin Afrilu kwata-kwata ba. Bayanai ukun farko ba su da amfani wajen hasashe.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi watsi da duk bayanan baya. Ka yi tunanin ko su alama ce ta ƙa’idar.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.d: Da alama kusan mutane 3,620,000 ne, amma yana iya zama ba daidai ba.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi magana da taka-tsantsan, amma ba ka yi amfani da yawan ƙarin da za a iya karantawa daga bayanan ba.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.explain: Kasancewar ya ƙaru da 100,000 a cikin watanni uku alama ce cewa mai yiwuwa zai ƙaru da adadi makamancin haka a Afrilu ma. Amma yawan ƙarin a Afrilu na iya bambanta, saboda haka ba za ka iya cewa “tabbas” ba. Yin watsi da duk bayanan (c) ko ƙin kula da yawan ƙarin (d) ma ba hasashe mai kyau ba ne.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.prompt: Yi bayanan da ke nuna cewa “tabbas” ɗin Mina na iya zama kuskure. A Janairu, Fabrairu da Maris yawan ya ƙaru da 100,000 kowanne; a Afrilu kuma bai ƙaru da 100,000 daga Maris ba. Duk bayanan lambobi ne masu lambobi bakwai, Janairu da Afrilu kuma ninkin 10,000 ne. Yi bayanai biyu masu ƙarin Afrilu daban-daban.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ka bar watanni ukun farko kamar misalin, sannan ka yi tunanin darajar Afrilu da ba ta fi Maris da 100,000 ba.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bayan ka zaɓi darajar Afrilu, ka duba cewa bambancinta da Maris ba 100,000 ba ne kuma ninkin 10,000 ce.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan bayanan lambobi ne masu lambobi bakwai.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne bayanan su zama lambobi masu lambobi bakwai daga 1,000,000 zuwa 9,999,999.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ne a rubuta Janairu da Afrilu a rukunin mutane 10,000 (ninkin 10,000).

y-m-10-06.s.s2.explain: Misali, 3,420,000 → 3,520,000 → 3,620,000 → 3,730,000 ya ƙaru da 100,000 a watanni uku na farko, sannan 110,000 a Afrilu. Bayanin da ya ragu, kamar 5,100,000 → 5,200,000 → 5,300,000 → 5,250,000, shi ma misali ne mai saba. Idan irin wannan bayani ko guda ɗaya mai yiwuwa ne, bayanan watanni uku kaɗai ba za su tabbatar da abin da Afrilu zai zama ba.

y-m-10-06.s.s3.model.0: Ina hasashen Afrilu zai kai kusan mutane 3,720,000. Domin ya ƙaru da 100,000 kowane wata daga Janairu zuwa Maris. Amma abubuwa ko yanayi a Afrilu na iya bambanta, don haka ina bukatar in ƙara sani game da hakan don in tabbatar.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.model.1: Ina tsammanin kusan mutane 3,720,000, amma ba zan ce tabbas haka ne ba. Gaskiya ne cewa an ƙara adadi iri ɗaya na watanni uku, amma Afrilu na iya canzawa dabam. Idan kuma ina da bayanin Mayu, zan fi iya amincewa da ƙa’idar.
